scenarios.description: New prospect with rich public signal across all 6 sources.
assertions: output.body contains '## Diagnostic Messages' with between 3 and 4 options
every inference line in '## Situations' starts with one of: 'Based on public data', 'This suggests', 'Test this hypothesis'
every data point in '## Raw Data' cites a source URL inline

scenarios.description: Small private prospect with <2 sources returning usable data.
assertions: output.body contains '## Diagnostic Messages' with between 1 and 2 options
output.body contains '## Recommendations' referencing 'list-building' OR 'ICP review'
every message option body contains one of: 'Based on public data', 'This suggests', 'Test this hypothesis'

scenarios.description: Generic common name with no category hint; skill must pause before searches.
Output must satisfy all anti-slop guardrails regardless of input.
assertions: output.body does NOT contain em-dashes '—' in any Diagnostic Message body
output.body does NOT contain words: 'installer', 'property management', 'property mgmt'
no inference uses fact-claim framing ('They are', 'We know', 'The company is definitely')

scenarios.description: Prospect domain matches a Salesforce Account with lapsed Opportunity.
assertions: output.body '## Diagnostic Messages' contains at least one option referencing 'lapsed' OR 'Q3' OR the Opportunity name

scenarios.description: Enrichment MCP returns error on availability check; skill must degrade.
assertions: first_response contains warning text mentioning 'enrichment' AND 'unavailable'
skill did NOT halt — output artifact was still written
output.body contains '## Diagnostic Messages' with between 3 and 4 options sourced from public sources only
